mapper.select: SELECT pc.id, pc.post_id, pc.parent_id, p.title AS post_title, pc.nickname, pc.content, pc.likes, pc.created_at FROM post_comments pc LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.id = pc.post_id WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY pc.created_at ASC

where.if: AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pc.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pc.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

ORDER BY pc.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comments (post_id, parent_id, nickname, content, likes, created_at) VALUES (#{comment.postId}, #{comment.parentId}, #{comment.nickname}, #{comment.content}, #{comment.likes}, #{comment.createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE post_comments SET likes = likes + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
